concrete_examples.current: NOT_REPLICATED, rel -4.99%, CI crosses 0, blocks=1 (<3), LOIO/placebo fail, materiality<2%
concrete_examples.minimal_change_to_flip: A new/extended non-parquet panel yielding >=3 non-overlapping 30d test blocks with C2-vs-B1 relative reduction >=2% favorable, CI excluding 0, LOIO and placebo passing, under a frozen pre-outcomes prereg; i.e. a materially different estimand/dataset than the sealed 1-block 2026Q3 recompute.

concrete_examples.current: BLOCKED_ON_DESIGN: mark+funding-only max 2 mutually non-overlapping blocks (<3)
concrete_examples.minimal_change_to_flip: At least 1 additional mutually non-overlapping mark+funding-only feasible block (total >=3) from an admissible untested window with complete train history, then a frozen prereg before outcomes and a passing confirmatory run.

Relative reduction >=2% with CI excluding 0 and LOIO/placebo passing on a pre-powered, preregistered design (>=23224 paired_n per power floor context where applicable) — would require different effect, not re-scoring.

exact_minimal_flip.description: Any single sealed NOT_MET/NOT_REPLICATED recompute study would need to become a pre-registered, independently reproducible promotable positive result under its own gates.
exact_minimal_flip.global_minimal_change: One promotable positive result on a trigger-satisfied, pre-powered (paired_n floors met), >=3-block, 7d-purge/embargo, pre-registered design with admissible observed data; OR a new untested cached-data design that is both design-feasible (>=3 mutually non-overlapping blocks) and yields a passing confirmatory result. Neither exists in current local cached frontier.

boundary_certificate.promotable_definition: materiality >=2% (|rel_reduction_pct|>=2 with favorable direction and CI excluding 0 per study gate) AND blocks>=3 AND other study gates pass; no study currently meets all.

estimand_heterogeneity_caveat.caveat: LOO rates and sign aggregation pool heterogeneous estimands (QLIKE vs Brier), horizons, and sample designs; they summarize programme-level corroboration, not a single estimand's sampling distribution. Within-tolerance reproduction is the stricter like-for-like criterion (2/7).
estimand_heterogeneity_caveat.designs: Different symbols/windows/block counts/data vintages (FCLR-002/003 2024 panels, FCLR-006/008/009 later panels, FCLR-010 liqmicro+hyperliquid funding, FCLR-013 2026Q3 ZIP/CSV 5-symbol).

qualitative_corroboration.definition: Independent recompute does not overturn the sealed qualitative programme verdict into a promotable positive claim (all 7: REPRODUCED_WITHIN_TOLERANCE/DIVERGED_BEYOND_TOLERANCE-agreeing-NOT_MET/NOT_REPLICATED).

sign_consistency_c2_vs_b1.note: Mixed signs across estimands/datasets: FCLR-002 positive, others negative or near-zero; no uniform directional effect.
